title: `teploy trigger poll --json`: one app's admission result (one JSON object per app; `--all` emits one line each, rev 14)

host.description: The server the poll ran against (empty for local timer mode).

ref.description: The polled ref (refs/heads/<branch>), or empty for a pre-refusal result such as a busy lock.

admitted.description: True only when this poll deployed a new commit.

deployed_release.description: The release version of the deploy this poll performed.
